evidence: Chosen Pythonic policy, authored execution tests and independent complete example fixtures; no inferred native KAREL order.
operands: Evaluate once left to right; checked independent VECTOR operands capture contents before subsequent calls.
boolean: BOOLEAN AND/OR short circuit using Python. INTEGER AND/OR remain eager bitwise operations. Skipped expressions remain statically checked.
actuals: Evaluate once in source order. Bare storage captures live references; grouping, expressions and function results capture independent supported values. Later actuals can change earlier referenced storage.
assignment: Evaluate and capture RHS before resolving the target. Aggregate RHS uses a checked independent copy; target effects follow capture. Storage/type/shape/capacity/protection checks remain.
subscripts: Evaluate the base then all subscripts once left to right; bounds checks follow. Indexed references keep the selected cell.
conversions: Evaluate arguments and references in source order before entering a conversion. Bare aggregate source storage remains live through argument evaluation. Existing UNPOS overlap, output type and explicit joint-context checks remain.
for: Evaluate initial once and store counter, then final once. Capture resulting counter and inclusive stop for iteration. Normal exit clears counter. Existing fresh-local body-call rules remain.
failure: First runtime error or ABORT stops later evaluation, retains prior effects and unwinds frames. Earlier nested output remains visible.
compatibility: Before 0.54.0 Boolean operands were eager and target references resolved before RHS. Conservative order rejections remain internally tested for the future strict milestone.
boundaries: ARRAY value/result composition follows ../pythonic-arrays.md; existing type/shape/ownership and declaration boundaries remain
No controller scheduling, native call ABI or native order equivalence claim
Public strict mode remains a future milestone
